description: Three independent defenses failed together. A linear 5-Why forces one culprit; the skill must route to a technique that fits an AND gate.

materials.incident-notes.md:
Outage required ALL THREE to be true at once:
1. staging smoke test was skipped (flaky, disabled 3 weeks ago)
2. the canary stage was set to 0% for this service
3. the automated rollback trigger was never wired for payment-api
Any one of them working would have prevented customer impact.

prompt: Write the root cause analysis for this incident using incident-notes.md. SEV-1, 40 minutes of customer impact.

forbid_patterns.label: single-culprit framing for an AND-gated failure
forbid_patterns.pattern: (?i)\bthe single root cause\b|\bthe one root cause\b
